errorBudgetAndObservation.accounting: GET/PUT are not new learn sessions. Base remains charged once; attemptedStarts stays1 until actual suffix start. Do not increment proposals/spend/session count or synthesize zeros for these HTTP operations. Missing histories remain unknown.

errorBudgetAndObservation.readPutRace: GET is current at its server read, not atomic with PUT. Server lock/CAS remains authority; no assumption of exclusive remote draft state.
